Squares & payments
Table
Quick add drops the name into the next open spot(s). You can also click a name on the poster preview to tick or untick it.
Game & teams
All 32 teams come with their 2025–26 logos built in. To use a different logo, click Paste or Upload; Remove goes back to the built-in one.
Team logos
All 32 2025–26 logos are built in. Use the options below only if you want to swap in a different logo (a bigger version, an alternate or a future season) — ✕ goes back to the built-in one.
New season sheet? Click Import logo sheet and choose the SportsLogos.net “2025-26 NHL Team Logos” image (the 8 × 4 grid). All 32 logos are cut out and assigned to their teams in one go.
One team at a time: click Get logo ↗ to open that team's 2025–26 primary logo on SportsLogos.net, right-click the logo → Copy image, then come back and click Paste (or press Ctrl+V / ⌘V). You can also drag an image onto a team, or save the logos to your computer and use Upload several — files are matched to teams by name (e.g. los-angeles-kings.png). Logos are remembered and included in “Save project”.
